clarity.title: Clarity
clarity.verified: key and tempo: Hooktheory (A flat major, 128 bpm) and SongBPM (G sharp / A flat major, 128 bpm). Chords: transcriptions differ (Hooktheory: ii7sus4 V7sus4 vi7 iii7 IV(add9); a guitar chord sheet: Ab Eb Fm Cm Db; the Vicetone remix on Hooktheory: III VII i VI in F minor, which is I V vi IV in A flat). The breakdown's E flat major and IV vi V I/3 are not supported.

red_lights.title: Red Lights
red_lights.verified: chords Gm Eb Bb F (i VI III VII in G minor, vi IV I V in B flat): a guitar chord sheet (Em C G D, capo 3). Key and tempo: AcousticBrainz (A sharp major, 125 bpm). Released December 2013, produced by Tiesto, Carl Falk and Rami Yacoub (Wikipedia). The voicing table, the envelopes and the ducking curve come from the breakdown only.

another_night.title: Another Night
another_night.verified: released 12 July 1993 by Hansa; rap written and performed by Olaf Jeglitza (O-Jay), the sung chorus by studio singer Karin Kasar; produced by Freshline (J. Wind and Quickmix) and the Berman Brothers (Wikipedia). 126 bpm (Mixgraph, which reads the key as G major). Chords unconfirmed: the breakdown gives Bm G A F#m, a chord sheet Am Dm G C. The hardware list (a JV-1080 came out in 1994) and the mix numbers come from the breakdown only.
